title: SMS Marketing for Retail Brands: 2026 Guide & Best Practices | Endear Blog

facts.fact: The page states that TCPA penalties are commonly cited at $500 to $1,500 per violation, per message.
facts.quote: commonly cited at $500-$1,500 per violation, per message

facts.fact: The page states that about two-thirds of customers are happy to be reached by brands via SMS when they have opted in.
facts.quote: About two-thirds of customers are happy to be reached by brands via SMS when they've opted in.

facts.fact: The page recommends keeping SMS messages to 160 characters, since going over splits the message into segments and doubles cost.
The page recommends starting SMS frequency at 1-2 texts per week and not exceeding about 10-12 texts per month.
facts.quote: start at 1-2 texts per week and work up; don't exceed ~10-12 per month.

facts.fact: The page states that mid-morning (10-11am) and early evening (5-7pm) in the recipient's local time zone consistently outperform other send times.
